Class Console

java.lang.Object
Console
public class Console extends Object
For playing in the console: a human plays X and the MCTSAgent plays O.

The console always holds a board and a reader of the keyboard (or of another input, for the tests), and a human move is only accepted when it is a free cell of the board.

      int getHumanMove()
      For reading in and interpreting the move that the user types into the console. It asks again until the user types the index of a free cell; it does not play the move.
      Returns:
      the index of a free cell of the board
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the input ends before a valid move is read
